until.description: YYYY-MM-DD (through the end of that day in the instance's time zone) or an RFC 3339 time; left out, until the finding resolves.

distrusted.description: An open distrusted_ca finding names it.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the DER, lower-case hex.

key.description: Such as RSA 2048 or ECDSA P-256.

served.description: Where it is served now: the addresses of each target's latest check.

kind.description: smtp, telegram, slack, discord, ntfy, webhook, teams, matrix or pagerduty.

unreadable.description: Its stored settings cannot be decrypted; enter them again.

recent_issuances.description: Issuances first seen in the last 30 days.

status.description: warning (an unexpected issuance or CAA violation), unreachable (the source fails), healthy, pending or disabled.

name.description: Required to add. Changing it starts the watch over.

subdomains.description: Watch the names below it too; true when adding.

code.description: Stable: unauthorized, forbidden, not_found, invalid, conflict, rate_limited, unsupported_media_type, too_large, node_offline, timeout, delivery_failed, poll_failed, unavailable, internal.

fields.description: What is wrong with each field, for invalid.

acknowledged.description: null when not acknowledged, or the acknowledgement has run out.

domain_id.description: Set for a finding on a domain watch.

endpoint.description: host:port of a target, the domain, or the node's hostname.

fingerprint.description: The certificate the finding is about, or for a domain watch the issuance id.

node_id.description: Set for a finding on a node (node_offline).

subject.description: The name of the target, watch or node.

target_id.description: Set for a finding on a target.

caa.description: The CAA verdict; empty when not judged.

fingerprint.description: The served certificate it matched, if any.

state.description: known (a target serves it), pending (waiting to be served), unexpected or acknowledged.

hour.description: 0 to 23, in the instance's time zone.

last_note.description: Why the last slot ran no scan, else empty.

last_scan_id.description: The last run's scan while it is kept.

name.description: A label; empty means the ranges.

node_id.description: The node the scan runs from; null: this server.

open_findings.description: Endpoints found that no target covers.

weekday.description: 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday; used for week.

every.description: day or week; required to add.

node_id.description: null: this server, unless Settings › General allows scans from nodes only.

ports.description: At most 16; the discovery defaults when left out.

ranges.description: Required to add: CIDRs or addresses, private unless Settings › General allows public discovery.

rate.description: 1 to 200 connects per second; 50 when left out.

weekday.description: 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday; Monday when left out.

current.description: It is the target's current certificate.

bundle_id.description: The CA bundle, with trust bundle.

channel_ids.description: The channels alerts go to; null for every channel.

days_left.description: Whole days until the earliest expiry on any address.

effective.description: The values in force after the defaults.

grade.description: A, B, C or F; empty before the first full test.

node_id.description: The node the target is probed from; null for this server.

pq.description: yes, no, or empty when untested.

protocol.description: tls, smtp, imap, pop3, ftp or postgres.

renewal_managed.description: Whether the target counts as renewal-managed now; auto decides by the issuer.

server_name.description: The SNI name sent; empty for none.

status.description: pending, healthy, warning, changed, acknowledged (every warning on it is acknowledged), critical, unreachable or disabled.

warn_days.description: An override; null follows Settings › Defaults. The same for the fields up to remind_crit_s.

host.description: A DNS name or IP address; required to add.

protocol.description: tls (the default), smtp, imap, pop3, ftp or postgres.

server_name.description: Defaults to a DNS host; follows the host when it changes along.

warn_days.description: null returns this and the other overrides to the default.
